title: When You Feel Stuck in a Life Transition
excerpt: When old patterns no longer fit and new ones are not yet clear, a few questions can help you slow down and notice what is actually changing.

body.text: Transitions can feel confusing because old patterns no longer fit, but new ones are not yet clear.
In these moments, it may help to slow down and ask:

items: What is actually changing in my life right now?
What feels uncertain — and what is still stable?
What expectations am I holding that no longer match reality?
What would it look like to give myself more time?

body.text: Stuckness is often not a lack of direction, but a process of adjustment.
